size.value: "Photographs must be: 45millimetres (length) x 35 millimetres" (35×45mm / 3.5×4.5cm — matches DB)

head_height.value: "The length of the face in the photograph should be 25mm to 35mm", with a margin of 3-4mm between the head and the edge of the photograph (matches DB's 2.5~3.5cm)

validity.value: "Photograph should not be taken more than six (6) months prior to submitting application"

clothing_restriction.value: "Applicants of dark complexion should wear coloured clothing and photographs should be taken against a white background"; "Applicants of light complexion must be photographed against a pastel-shaded wall" and should avoid wearing white clothing. Avoid exposed shoulders/chest and bright colours.

glasses_policy.value: "Tinted lenses are prohibited"; "Heavy (thick) frames should be avoided"

headwear_policy.value: Headgear permitted ONLY for religious purposes, and must be declared/completed on a special application form section

face_visibility.value: "Facial features including the outline of the face from the bottom of the chin to top of the forehead must be clearly shown"

official_source_url.value: https://www.pica.gov.jm/passport/photo-requirements (Passport, Immigration and Citizenship Agency — PICA, Jamaica's official passport-issuing authority)

clothing.en: Clothing depends on complexion: dark-complexioned applicants should wear coloured clothing (photographed against a white background); light-complexioned applicants must avoid white clothing (photographed against a pastel background). Avoid exposed shoulders/chest and bright colours.
clothing.ko: 안색에 따라 의상 규정이 다르다: 어두운 안색은 유색 의상을 착용(흰색 배경 촬영), 밝은 안색은 흰색 의상을 피해야 한다(파스텔 배경 촬영). 어깨·가슴 노출과 밝은 원색은 피할 것.
clothing.ja: 肌の色によって服装の規定が異なる:色黒の申請者は色付きの服を着用(白背景で撮影)、色白の申請者は白い服を避ける(パステル背景で撮影)。肩や胸の露出、明るい原色は避けること。

glasses.en: Tinted lenses are prohibited; heavy (thick) frames should be avoided.
glasses.ko: 색깔 있는 렌즈(선팅)는 금지되며, 두꺼운 안경테는 피해야 한다.
glasses.ja: 色付きレンズは禁止。太い眼鏡フレームは避けること。

headwear.en: Headgear is permitted only for religious purposes and must be declared on a special section of the application form.
headwear.ko: 머리가리개는 종교적 목적에 한해서만 허용되며, 신청서의 별도 항목에 명시해야 한다.
headwear.ja: 頭部を覆うものは宗教上の目的の場合のみ許可され、申請書の専用欄にその旨を明記する必要がある。

face_visibility.en: Facial features, including the outline of the face from the bottom of the chin to the top of the forehead, must be clearly shown.
face_visibility.ko: 턱 아래부터 이마 위까지 얼굴 윤곽을 포함한 이목구비가 명확히 드러나야 한다.
face_visibility.ja: あごの下から額の上まで、顔の輪郭を含む目鼻立ちがはっきりと写っている必要がある。

db_conflicts.research_value: Complexion-dependent, not uniformly white: dark-complexioned applicants are photographed against a WHITE background; light-complexioned applicants against a PASTEL background (beige, pale pink, etc.) and told to avoid white clothing; applicants with grey/white hair are photographed against a pale blue or pastel background.
